$comment: Deliberate, named deltas between a vendored copy and its canonical upstream. Keyed by the sync guard's title (`vendor` for the friction scorer against willow-gate, `mem_ratify` against the willow repo), then the vendored file name. Each record is (why, sha256 of the exact body it excuses): scripts/vendor_drift.py forgives that body and no other, and fails the job the moment upstream carries the change and the record is no longer true. A record is a claim about the tree, dated and hashed, never a blanket permission — and it is the third thing a re-sync removes, after the body and the pin. Empty today: the one delta this was written for (nest/secrets.py against safe-app-store) ended when safe-app-store was archived and the Nest pipeline's home became this repo (owner decision, 2026-09-12).
